_purpose: #679: which page of the shipped documentation explains a setting -- the 'Read in this version's documentation' link under a setting's More info. 'categories' maps a Settings-page category (config/settings.catalog.locked.json categories) to 'page' or 'page#anchor'; 'settings' maps one setting by its internal name and wins over its category. A link is shown only when its page and anchor exist in this folder (never a dead link); the web tests fail on any entry that does not resolve. SecurityInsight's own file: setup/Import-SIProductDocs.ps1 never replaces it.
